{{Quote|<nowiki />''[...]'' Mandalore the Hammerborn grew up in the alleys of Kol Atorn, learning accented Mando'a from the emigrants and exiles who had settled there.|Tor Vizsla, ''Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad''|<ref name="BHC" />}}
'''Kol Atorn''' was an astronomical object located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]]. It was [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] emigrants and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiles]]. An individual grew up in the alleys of Kol Atorn and learned an accented version of the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] [[Language/Legends|language]] from the celestial body's settlers. The individual eventually became a famed Mandalorian [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|leader]] with the title [[Mandalore the Hammerborn]].

==Description==
Kol Atorn was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="BHC" /> situated in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Kol Atorn system/Legends|same name]], a part of the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Kol Atorn was located far from [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="BHC" /> the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that served as the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The celestial body's surface featured alleys.<ref name="BHC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Remember that some of the greatest Mandalores were born or grew up far from our homeworld.|Tor Vizsla, ''Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad''|<ref name="BHC" />}}
Kol Atorn was eventually [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by Mandalorian emigrants and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiles]] who spoke an accented version of the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] [[Language/Legends|language]], and the celestial body became an enclave of the Mandalorian culture. An individual grew up in Kol Atorn's alleys and learned to speak ''Mando'a'' from the Mandalorians residing there. The individual eventually became one of the greatest [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalores]], leaders of the Mandalorian people, specifically coming to be known as [[Mandalore the Hammerborn]].<ref name="BHC" />

Mandalore the Hammerborn's origin on Kol Atorn was noted in ''[[Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad]]'', a manifesto of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] Mandalorian splinter group. The document was supposedly [[Author/Legends|written]] by the movement's [[Secret Mandalore|leader]], [[Tor Vizsla]]&mdash;although the Death Watch's opponent [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] doubted its authenticity&mdash;and was eventually included in the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]'' by Jango's son, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="BHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kol Atorn was introduced in the [[2013]] reference book ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''.<ref name="BHC" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Kol Atorn system, and therefore the celestial body Kol Atorn, in grid square N-4.<ref name="EAOC" />
